title: n8n Free Plan 2026: None on Cloud, Starter Is $20/mo
summary: The n8n free plan includes unlimited workflow storage but caps monthly executions and excludes advanced features like SSO and priority support.
body_markdown:
## Activepieces for the same job without n8n's caps


### Licence and hosting


The Activepieces pricing page lists unlimited flows on every plan from Free through Ultimate; what it meters is credits per run, never how many flows exist. That matters because of the habit this article keeps returning to, the one fragile workflow that does everything.


Zapier charges a task for each action and Make a credit for each module, so on both, breaking it into ten maintainable integrations makes every run cost more. On Activepieces the ten flows add nothing to the bill by existing.


MoneyGram, Moneypenny, Alan and FundingSocieties run it, on an MIT-licensed core you can self-host or use on the free cloud plan.


That doesn't make the cost disappear. Self-hosting the MIT-licensed core of Activepieces still means someone patches it, watches the disk and restores it after a bad upgrade, which is the same server time the previous section priced for n8n.


What changes is the licence: MIT lets you modify and redistribute the code, where n8n's Sustainable Use License sets limits on commercial use. If you resell or embed automation, read both licences before you build on either.


### Rebuilding a common job


Take a job that's common in n8n setups: pull new rows on a schedule, filter them, write the results somewhere else.


In Activepieces the trigger is the[Schedule piece](https://www.activepieces.com/pieces/schedule) , and the next step can be[Google Sheets](https://www.activepieces.com/pieces/google-sheets) , one of the 743 integrations in the open source monorepo and the destination here, so you can likely connect your scheduled workflows to the other tools in your stack.


The builder below shows that start: an hourly Schedule trigger with a sample run marked as tested, and the step picker open on spreadsheet actions such as Insert Row and Find Rows.


Before you add the second step, you can test the first against real output. A broken trigger shows up at step one rather than after the whole flow is built.


For an AI step, the[OpenAI piece](https://www.activepieces.com/pieces/openai) slots in after the filter the same way as any other action.


### Moving over from n8n


You rebuild this by hand.


Activepieces doesn't import or convert n8n workflows, so budget the time to recreate each flow, and treat the move as worth it only if the caps or the licence are what's hurting you, since what you get in return is an MIT-licensed core and unlimited flows on every plan.


[Sign up for Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) on the free plan, which comes with 1,000 credits a month and no card, and rebuild one small workflow first to see how it behaves.
